Item.Description: Products requiring excise tax, a printed copy of the electronic administrative document (e-DA) may be used for crediting
Form 302. This form, bearing the code "T2L" or "T2LF" and authenticated by the customs office of departure, shall be used as proof of Union status
ATA bearing the code "T2L" or "T2LF" and authenticated by the customs office of departure shall serve as a reference
Paper T2L: When the proof obtained in the Member State of departure is out of POUS system and has no POUS MRN
Shortages: When the Summary Declaration (DST) to be written off has more quantity in relation to the T2L POUS
